notes.title: Patch v0.11.0-704: Bug fixes, Optimizations and Tweaks
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added sounds to bossfight cinematics.
[*] Tweaks to final bossfight stage.
[*] Applied some optimizations to the rendering of the boleadoras.
[*] Applied optimizations that should improve performance in Ants Nest and Unstable Cave.
[*] Fix bug that could cause player to be trapped in an underwater checkpoint.
[*] Fixed crashes that happened seemingly at random and were related to steam achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE 1 OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
With your help we continue to improve Runa! The first update after our Early Access launch is now live! 🎮✨

We've been reading your feedback and working non-stop to bring you new content. We hope you like it! 💚

Keep enjoying Runa, and don't forget to share your adventures with us. Thank you for being part of this project! We couldn't do it without you.

We'll be waiting for your feedback!

notes.title: Update: ¡Alpha 0.3.0 is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/b915e22f19bd2a5e300bdbe1c74663f64a9380cb.png[/img]

[h1]Alpha v0.3.0[/h1]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Fixed bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A message saying that a saved game will be overwritten was being displayed when pressing new game for the first time.
[*] When restarting from a checkpoint, some levels took a couple seconds to load, leaving an empty space. Now the game doesn't start until the levels in sight are loaded.
[*] Fixed music played when getting one of the seals.
[*] Fixed Runa's charged attack walking animation.
[/list]

[h3]Enhancements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added hat to the capybara after labyrinth.
[*] Changed color to breakable rocks in cave.
[*] Added more decorations to cave, chaikuru ruins, air temple and observatory road's environment,.
[*] Added skybox.
[*] Fixed textures in air temple and chaikuru ruins.
[*] Fixed grass on graveyard.
[*] Modified camera when getting the boleadoras.
[*] Minor adjustments to Chaikur Ruins' puzzle.
[*] Added Yaguareté seal mark to elements that can be interacted by using that seal.
[*] Added some more hints to the Narinas' walkie-talkie.
[*] Bossfight was redesigned.
[/list]
